summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. We close by talking about the continued purpose of
hedged funds, due diligence tricks, preparing for unexpected risk, managing time, and philanthropy. It can also be a very
positive in some strategies, but in the strategies that we're looking at, which are real fundamental
growth, adding value post-close, helping improve the management team.
